# package: ./crash/
why this floor and not 1.0: 110 survivors of 450. Most are equivalents or paths no test can reach: bounds set with measured headroom (maxBytes, maxNameLen, the n>=63 guard, the 16-hex digest), which no assertion can pin by construction; the recorder's mutex (only -race sees it, and go-mutesting does not run with it); a removed t.Helper; and error returns a real filesystem does not take under test (readTree, writeTo, and the replay control's own two). Three are real gaps, recorded rather than hidden: no scenario writes twice on one handle, so f.off += reads the same as f.off =; no scenario has two pending splittable writes at one crash point, so SplitAtCrashOnly's guard in units is unpinned; and no reference store puts a file under a nested directory, so the rename's second-directory term in split is unpinned.
